faq_q_1: Do I need my own WhatsApp Business number?
faq_a_1: No — Kedaipal runs one Meta-verified WhatsApp Business Account for all sellers. No Meta business verification, no waiting weeks for approval. Your store name appears in every message.
faq_q_2: Do I need a registered company?
faq_a_2: No. Kedaipal handles all WhatsApp Business API access centrally — you never need to register with Meta. A registered company is not required to use Kedaipal.
faq_a_3: Two ways. Connect your own HitPay account and buyers tap Pay now — DuitNow QR, FPX, cards, e-wallets — with the money settling straight to you and the order marking itself paid. Or take bank transfer / cash: Kedaipal sends your payment details, tracks the “I've paid” handshake, and issues the receipt. Kedaipal never touches your order money.
faq_a_4: Kedaipal currently supports English, Bahasa Malaysia, and Chinese. Tamil is on the roadmap.
faq_a_5: No. WhatsApp is where most sellers start because it's the channel their customers already use every day — but the same dashboard also powers your web storefront and in-person counter checkout, so your online and walk-in orders live in one place.
faq_q_6: What kinds of businesses is Kedaipal for?
faq_a_6: Kedaipal is built for any seller with a product catalog — F&B, fashion, beauty, handmade goods, home products, and more — taking 20+ orders a week on WhatsApp.
faq_a_7: You do. Every product, order and customer record is yours — CSV export is on the dashboard today. Cancel anytime and take everything with you.
faq_a_8: Not until you sell. Sign up and set up free, with no credit card. Your first order starts 14 days or 200 orders — whichever comes first — of everything in Pro, and brings your first invoice, due when those 14 days are up: pick your plan and pay it then. If you haven't sold within 14 days of signing up, we send that first invoice anyway so your account never sits in limbo — pay it to keep going, or cancel and owe nothing.
faq_q_9: Business goes quiet for a season — do I keep paying?
faq_a_9: No. Durian's done, Raya's over, the night market shuts for a month — pause your subscription at RM 19 a month (S$9) instead of paying the full plan or cancelling and losing the lot. Products, orders and customers stay exactly where you left them, and your storefront tells buyers you're on a break. Resume whenever, in one tap.
faq_a_10: A solo founder (Arif Rahman) building with the sellers who pay for it — real businesses transact through Kedaipal daily and shape the roadmap every week. Not a big team, but you'll always reach a person.
faq_q_11: I sell custom-made orders — can buyers approve a design first?
faq_a_11: Yes. Mark a product as needing mockup approval and its orders can't enter production until the buyer signs off on their tracking page. Payment is only asked for after approval — and if a buyer goes quiet, you can waive the gate after 48 hours.
faq_q_12: I sell at a stall too — does that work?
faq_a_12: Yes — that's exactly who we built for. Counter checkout gives your stall one QR: walk-ins scan, order and pair to WhatsApp on the spot. Counter and chat orders share one inbox, one stock count, and one customer list.
faq_a_13: Any courier on your own Delyva account — J&T Express, Ninja Van, Pos Malaysia, DHL eCommerce, City-Link, Flash Express and cold-chain lanes like Ninja Cold — quoted from the order, cheapest first, with the tracking number sent to your buyer on WhatsApp. Lalamove covers same-day riders in Malaysia and Singapore. Delyva's Singapore couriers are being enabled.
faq_q_14: Can I run a sale without reposting every price?
faq_a_14: Yes. Put one product or a whole category on sale with one percentage off and an end time — buyers see the old price struck through and a live countdown, and prices snap back by themselves. For a flash sale, cap the units and let unpaid orders cancel themselves so the stock goes back on sale. Voucher codes work the same way for a regular, an apology or a giveaway: one code, one use, shareable as a link or a QR for your counter. All on Pro.
faq_q_15: Can my helper use it without seeing my bank details?
faq_a_15: Yes. Invite them by email and pick, area by area, what they can reach — orders only for whoever packs, orders and products for a manager, and nothing near your money unless you say so. They sign in as themselves, so the order timeline names who confirmed it and who rang it up at the counter. Pro includes two teammates; Enterprise has no limit.
faq_q_16: I'm in Singapore, or my buyers are overseas — does it work?
faq_a_16: Yes. Singapore stores price in S$, take PayNow and cards through HitPay, and book Lalamove riders from the order. And a buyer with a Singaporean, Indonesian or Japanese WhatsApp number picks their own flag at checkout — no more “number not accepted” at the last step.

pricingpage_faq_q1: Can I switch plans as my orders grow?
pricingpage_faq_a1: Yes — from Settings → Billing, any time. Moving up starts straight away: the days you've already paid for carry over, and the extra credits are added to this month at once. Moving down waits until the period you've paid for ends, so nothing is taken back before then. You can also cancel anytime; your data is kept for 90 days.
pricingpage_faq_a2: Each order has a single pickup/delivery address. Multi-pickup-point routing — where one order can have different pickup locations (e.g. several collection points for a batch run) — is coming to Enterprise; it isn't live yet.
pricingpage_faq_q3: How does Lalamove delivery work, and what about frozen or outstation orders?
pricingpage_faq_a3: Lalamove rider booking is live on Pro and Enterprise, using your own Lalamove account. Buyers see a live rider quote at checkout, and you dispatch in one tap from a packed order — motorcycle or car — with the tracking link pushed to the buyer automatically. That covers intra-city delivery. For frozen or outstation parcels you set up courier rate cards instead: your own zones and weight bands for J&T, DD Cold Chain, Ninja Cold and the rest, then paste the consignment number when you ship. Rate cards are on every plan.
pricingpage_faq_q4: What payment methods can my customers use?
pricingpage_faq_a4: Two rails, both settling straight to you. Connect your own HitPay account and buyers tap Pay now — DuitNow QR, FPX from every bank, Touch 'n Go, GrabPay, ShopeePay, Boost, Visa/Mastercard. Or take bank transfer, DuitNow QR and cash by hand, with the “I've paid” handshake and receipts. Kedaipal never touches your order money; HitPay's gateway fee is billed to you directly and we add nothing on top.
pricingpage_faq_a5: Not until you sell — sign up free, no credit card. Your first order gives you {days} days or {orders} orders, whichever comes first, to try everything in Pro, and brings your first invoice: pick Starter or Pro and pay it before those {days} days are up. Haven't sold by day {backstopDay}? The invoice comes then instead, on the same terms. Cancel before paying and you owe nothing.
pricingpage_faq_q6: Does Kedaipal work if my customers are already chatting me on personal WhatsApp?
pricingpage_faq_a6: Yes. Your customers keep messaging whatever number they have for you. Kedaipal is a storefront + order system that connects via the CTA URL button in your WhatsApp Business profile — customers tap it, browse, cart, and the order comes back to you in WhatsApp. No app download, no new number.
pricingpage_faq_a7: 1 credit = 1 order you keep, whatever its size. Every plan includes credits each month — {starter} on Starter, {pro} on Pro, and whatever your contract sets on Enterprise — and one is used when an order comes in, on any channel. If an order never gets going, its credit comes back: a booking request that expires unanswered, an unpaid claim-link order that lapses, a buyer who backs out, or a new order you cancel before accepting it (up to {refunds} a month). Your buyers never see credits.
pricingpage_faq_a8: No. Starter and Pro keep their monthly prices, and the credits are included in them — they're not a new charge. You only ever pay more if you choose to top up or move up a plan.
pricingpage_faq_q9: What happens if I run out of credits?
pricingpage_faq_a9: Your shop keeps taking every order — the storefront never pauses, and your buyers never notice. Orders that arrive while you're at zero wait on credits: you can see that they came in and what they're worth, but not open them until credits land, and they open oldest first. Everything you've already paid a credit for carries on as normal, as do your products and settings — and you can always cancel an order to release the buyer.
pricingpage_faq_a10: Your plan's monthly credits don't — they reset at the start of each month. Credits you buy as a top-up last {months} months from the day you buy them, and they're only used once your monthly credits run out.
pricingpage_faq_q11: Do I get the same credits on the annual plan?
pricingpage_faq_a11: Yes. Annual plans get the same credits every month — never all twelve months at once — and the number is locked in for the year you've paid for.
